questions.prompt: How often do you feel emotionally exhausted at the end of a work day?
How often do you feel detached or cynical about your job?
How confident do you feel about your work?
How often do you feel physically tired?
How often do you feel positive about your job?

interpretation.low: Low burnout risk - Keep up the great work!
interpretation.moderate: Moderate burnout risk - Consider taking regular breaks and self-care.
interpretation.high: High burnout risk - Please consider reaching out to HR or a mental health professional.
